source_documents.title: Conformationally controlled thermally activated delayed fluorescence in a nitro-substituted phenothiazine: a combined spectroscopic and kinetic study

reference_evidence_units.quote: In CHX, the oxygen sensitivity and lifetime of the delayed emission, its spectral overlap with prompt fluorescence, and the temperature-dependent emission behavior collectively support its assignment to TADF.
reference_evidence_units.subject: NPh-PTZ

reference_evidence_units.quote: Calculations further suggest that differences in spinorbit coupling (SOC) and singlet–triplet energy separation between the axial and equatorial conformers may contribute to the observed behavior.
